verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcast API lets a caller create a draft or schedule a send, targeted by segment or tag IDs (kit-docs-66). The hosted Kit MCP exposes broadcasts and segments for AI clients to read and write, and its docs give "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers" as an example of a prompt that becomes a real account action. A draft created this way sits unsent until a human finishes it, and drafts or scheduled broadcasts can be updated or deleted before sending. Missing for 10: no documented approval gate (sign-off step, approver role, or approval notification) beyond the draft/scheduled state, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-to-human review flow.
